illustration.captionEn: To everyone's amazement, the shy boy delivered a brilliant speech in front of the whole school.
illustration.captionZh: 讓所有人驚訝的是，那個害羞的男孩在全校面前發表了一場精彩的演講。

illustration.captionEn: Being late for class without a good reason is not acceptable.
illustration.captionZh: 沒有正當理由而上課遲到是不可接受的。

illustration.captionEn: Since they don't speak the same language, they communicate mostly through simple gestures.
illustration.captionZh: 由於他們不會說同一種語言，大部分時候是透過簡單的手勢來溝通。

illustration.captionEn: Cotton shirts often shrink a little after the first wash.
illustration.captionZh: 棉質襯衫在第一次洗滌後通常會稍微縮水。

illustration.captionEn: In the story, a brave knight rescues the princess from the dragon's tower.
illustration.captionZh: 在故事中，一位勇敢的騎士從惡龍的高塔中救出公主。

illustration.captionEn: The museum displays a golden crown that once belonged to an ancient queen.
illustration.captionZh: 博物館展示了一頂曾屬於古代王后的金色王冠。

illustration.captionEn: To her horror, she found a snake in her bag.
illustration.captionZh: 令她驚恐的是，她在包包裡發現了一條蛇。

illustration.captionEn: There is a generation gap between my grandmother and me when it comes to technology.
illustration.captionZh: 在科技方面，我和祖母之間存在代溝。

illustration.captionEn: My grandmother, though elderly, still goes for a walk every morning.
illustration.captionZh: 我奶奶雖然年紀大了，還是每天早上都會去散步。

illustration.captionEn: He gently tapped his classmate on the shoulder to get her attention.
illustration.captionZh: 他輕輕拍了一下同學的肩膀，想引起她的注意。

illustration.captionEn: The faucet in our kitchen has been leaking for two days.
illustration.captionZh: 我們家廚房的水龍頭已經漏水兩天了。

illustration.captionEn: He is a loyal follower of the local basketball team.
illustration.captionZh: 他是當地籃球隊的忠實支持者。

illustration.captionEn: As a frequent traveler, he always packs light.
illustration.captionZh: 身為一位常常旅行的人，他總是輕裝簡從。

illustration.captionEn: As a responsible citizen, he always recycles his trash.
illustration.captionZh: 身為一個負責任的公民，他總是會做好垃圾回收。

illustration.captionEn: Can you pass me the pen holder on the desk?
illustration.captionZh: 你可以把桌上的筆筒遞給我嗎？

illustration.captionEn: Her sudden decision to quit the job astonished everyone in the office.
illustration.captionZh: 她突然決定辭職，讓辦公室裡的每個人都感到驚訝。

illustration.captionEn: To our astonishment, the little boy solved the puzzle in two minutes.
illustration.captionZh: 令我們驚訝的是，那個小男孩兩分鐘就解開了這個謎題。

illustration.captionEn: She accepted the invitation with a smile.
illustration.captionZh: 她微笑著接受了邀請。

illustration.captionEn: That's a really attractive dress—where did you buy it?
illustration.captionZh: 那件洋裝真好看，你在哪買的？

illustration.captionEn: It took us all afternoon to erect the tent at the campsite.
illustration.captionZh: 我們花了整個下午才在營地把帳篷搭起來。

illustration.captionEn: My grandfather is still alive and healthy at the age of ninety.
illustration.captionZh: 我爺爺九十歲了，仍然健在又健康。

illustration.captionEn: Text messages have become one of the most common forms of communication today.
illustration.captionZh: 簡訊已成為現今最常見的溝通方式之一。

illustration.captionEn: Many students feel a fear of public speaking before their oral presentations.
illustration.captionZh: 許多學生在口頭報告前會對公開演說感到恐懼。

illustration.captionEn: When the fire alarm rang loudly, students rushed out of the building in panic.
illustration.captionZh: 當火災警報大聲響起時，學生們驚慌地衝出建築物。

illustration.captionEn: The heavy box fell and cracked the glass table in the living room.
illustration.captionZh: 那個重箱子掉下來，把客廳的玻璃桌子弄裂了。

illustration.captionEn: The community built a new center where the youth can play sports after school.
illustration.captionZh: 社區蓋了一座新的中心，讓年輕人放學後可以運動。

illustration.captionEn: Sales of ice cream usually peak in the hottest weeks of summer.
illustration.captionZh: 冰淇淋的銷量通常在夏天最熱的幾週達到最高點。

illustration.captionEn: She became famous after winning the national swimming championship last year.
illustration.captionZh: 她去年贏得全國游泳錦標賽冠軍後聲名大噪。

illustration.captionEn: This shirt is too loose for me.
illustration.captionZh: 這件襯衫對我來說太鬆了。

illustration.captionEn: To everyone's relief, the lost child was found safe near the park.
illustration.captionZh: 令大家都鬆了一口氣的是，走失的孩子在公園附近被平安尋獲。

illustration.captionEn: Local residents were asked to leave the area before the typhoon arrived.
illustration.captionZh: 在颱風來襲之前，當地居民被要求撤離該地區。

illustration.captionEn: There has been a significant change in the weather this week.
illustration.captionZh: 這星期的天氣有了顯著的變化。
